Verify my-org/my-dataset

This dataset was published with Attestrum. The Sigstore Bundle at attestrum/bundle.sigstore.json attests that the sealed manifest at attestrum/manifest.parquet was signed by the identity below.

Identity policy

Certificate identity (SAN)
https://github.com/my-org/my-dataset/.github/workflows/build.yml@refs/heads/main
OIDC issuer
https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

Verify from the command line

You can verify the bundle with stock Sigstore tooling — no Attestrum install required:

cosign verify-blob-attestation \
  --new-bundle-format \
  --bundle attestrum/bundle.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/my-org/my-dataset/.github/workflows/build.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  attestrum/manifest.parquet

For richer offline verification (Merkle-root re-derivation against the manifest), see attestrum verify at github.com/Attestrum/Attestrum.

Attestrum v0.1 — static verify page. In-browser WASM verifier ships in v0.2.
